title_as_printed: The solubility of O2 in water and seawater (S = 35.77) as a function of temperature.

footnotes_as_printed.a: The measurements were made on solutions in equilibrium with the atmosphere saturated with water vapor.
footnotes_as_printed.b: Calculated from the equations of Garcia and Gordon (1992). The values in seawater are in umol (kg soln)-1.
footnotes_as_printed.c: The values in parentheses were calculated from the equations of Weiss (1970).

pressure_note: Solubilities in moist air were corrected to a total pressure of 1 atm from the measured atmospheric pressures (+-1 mbar); 'The measurements were made on solutions in equilibrium with the atmosphere saturated with water vapor.' Small correction for water vapour pressure being constant when correcting to 1 atm was neglected.
gas_basis_evidence: O2 from air; result is the dissolved O2 amount per kg H2O ('we report the solubilities in umol (kg H2O)-1 or molality (m)'), not a gas mole fraction
volume_basis_evidence: 'we report the solubilities in umol (kg H2O)-1 or molality (m)'; solutions were made by volume and converted to molality with density equations (Lo Surdo et al., 1982)
extra_unmapped: Delta umol kg^-1 (difference measured minus calculated, derived)
conversion_needs: P is 1 atm total pressure of moist air, not O2 partial pressure; builder needs the O2 mole fraction in dry air and water vapour pressure if partial pressure is wanted
standard_conditions_note: Not applicable (no gas volumes); the paper does not define standard conditions.

value.what: measured O2 solubility; water rows per kg H2O; for seawater rows the paper does not say whether the measured value is per kg H2O or per kg solution (footnote b says the calculated seawater values are per kg solution)

value2.what: Garcia and Gordon (1992) fit of Benson and Krause data, with Weiss (1970) value in parentheses

composition.other_species: Water rows: pure water (ion-exchanged); no salt. Seawater rows (held): seawater of practical salinity S = 35.77 (composition not given)

notes: Calibration/validation table of the apparatus; temperatures printed to 0.01 C. The Calculated cell holds two values as printed: the Garcia-Gordon fit value followed by the Weiss value in parentheses. Seawater rows kept although composition is not given (practical salinity only).

air_equilibrated.evidence: solution equilibrated with water-vapour-saturated air, corrected to 1 atm total (p.2351); the O2 mole fraction of dry air is not printed in the paper; standard-air value taken from the Garcia and Gordon convention the paper compares with (coordinator precedent, audit 2026-10-02)

row_held.reason: seawater rows: measured O2 is per kg H2O (text) or per kg solution (footnote b) and the sea-salt composition is not given; basis not established

quality_remarks: Printed inconsistency: the parenthesised Weiss values in the Calculated column equal the Measured column in all ten rows, while the parenthesised Deltas imply different Weiss values (e.g. 396.9 + 0.7 = 397.6); probably a printing error, no effect since the Calculated column is literature. Seawater unit ambiguous: text says umol (kg H2O)-1, footnote b says umol (kg soln)-1 for the calculated seawater values, and measured-minus-calculated is only -1.0 to +1.4, which is possible only if the measured seawater values are also per kg solution.
